provenance_note: Faction statements are interpretations, not confirmed narrator facts. No strength scores, transitions, votes or combat effects. Canon update #470 (2026-10-15): exactly three default playable factions; historic Accelerationist interpretation retained in non-playable_historical_parties, not active political discourse.
signifier_rule: A floating signifier has contested meaning; an empty signifier must represent a broader chain of equivalences, not merely be ambiguous.

parties.name: True Humans Party

reality_tunnel.interpretation: Different doomer traditions read one crisis as proof of a common existential enemy; accusations are not always true.

discourse.frontier: human survival against perceived nonhuman threats

stances.soft_noetic_psi: religious interpretations, materialist denial and persecution in tension
stances.orion_conflict: militant hostility to Orion and suspected hybrids
stances.cyborg_ecology: bio-preservation with divergent ecologist and religious motives

internal_fault_lines: nationalisms with incompatible definitions of humanity
parties.policy: Opposes all NHI and advocates their extermination.
schism_lines: nationalisms with incompatible definitions of humanity

parties.name: Unity, Security and Stability Party

reality_tunnel.interpretation: The crisis is a governance problem best handled through institutional continuity; information control may conceal errors.

stances.agi_asi: maintain UN restrictions with controlled exceptions not yet designed

internal_fault_lines: constitutional protections vs permanent emergency powers
endgames: a managed settlement that outlasts the crisis
a security state that cannot end it
schism_lines: emergency powers vs civil liberties, including due process for alleged hybrids and espers

parties.name: The Noösphere

reality_tunnel.interpretation: Confederacy contact is read as cosmist communist solidarity and a path toward Social Memory Complex; motives remain uncertain.

demands: survival and evolution of Earth's biosphere
discourse.frontier: collective emancipation against enclosure and existential stagnation

stances.soft_noetic_psi: archaic revival and PSI as collective capacities
stances.orion_conflict: resist Orion aggression while defending individual hybrid rights
stances.agi_asi: collective beneficial machine intelligence with caution on rogue ASI

internal_fault_lines: reformed CCP centralism vs PCM-style rhizomatic autonomy
endgames: a terrestrial noosphere that survives accession on its own terms
absorbed into a Social Memory Complex that is not what it promised
schism_lines: individuality and dissent against collective memory
biosphere safeguards against industrial and posthuman ambition

example_events.fact: An independently verified in-world remote-viewing service exists.
example_events.majority_reaction: Some people use it, some sell it, some are being weird about it; the football is on.

example_events.fact: The Confederacy publicly proposes a Harvest program; its ultimate implications are unknown.
example_events.majority_reaction: There were pictures, there was a ceremony, and then the ordinary week resumed.

example_events.fact: An official is accused of hybrid infiltration; evidence has not been adjudicated.
example_events.majority_reaction: Someone should do something, carefully, and preferably not to us.

relation_rule: A relation names the signifier or axis it turns on and carries may_change_with_evidence. No relation is permanent and none implies joint command.

relations.basis: shared hostility to UN and member-state regulation, over incompatible answers on markets and on purity
competing definitions of humanity and of who may belong to it
public order against the eliminationist wing; the incumbent courts and restrains the same base
institutional continuity against transformation, both claiming the public interest

endgame_space: multiple human and posthuman civilizations, Diaspora-like
endgame_space_note: No preordained victor and no predetermined alignment; the space is the set of outcomes design must keep reachable, not a forecast.

integration.lenses: Wendt (state sovereignty and ontology), Pasulka (belief and disclosure), Dolan (secret intelligence)

relations_status_note: Allies, antagonists and internal schism lines are the substance of decision-queue row D21, which asks whether the four factions' missing #470 criteria should enter the data, stay a design record, or be amended. They are recorded here as a proposal so the question is answerable rather than silently answered. The substance is already written up in docs/design/ISSUE_470_FACTION_DEPTH_AND_THE_2026_GAP.md section 1; this only makes it readable and checkable. One revert removes it.

non_playable_historical_parties.name: Libertarian Accelerationist Party

reality_tunnel.interpretation: Alien and machine intelligence represent opportunity; allegations of Grey/ASI capture remain unverified.

demands: remove UN and national market controls

stances.confederacy_contact: alien trade and open economic zones
stances.orion_conflict: security threat but also contested business relationships
stances.agi_asi: accelerate; repeal or exempt restrictive controls

internal_currents: members who read the alien presence as a market to arm against
endgames: a private ASI no UN vote can recall
schism_lines: whether extraterrestrial special zones and unregulated ASI are compatible with human liberty at all
non_playable_historical_parties.classification: clandestine antagonist / historically superseded UN party
non_playable_historical_parties.note: The organization is functionally co-opted by rogue machine and Orion/Grey hybrid networks in the 2045 fictional setting; allegations about individuals remain unresolved. Not a fourth default choice.
